notes: Page header reads 'REGISTER OF' — likely a church membership or communicants register. Some surnames are difficult to read in cursive. Several entries marked 'By Certificate' in the 'To whom Married' or received column, indicating transfer by certificate from another congregation. Row numbers jump from [16] to [145] suggesting this is a partial page from a larger register. Some last names are uncertain: McShadden, Himbree, Heair, McSpadden, Jacke, Hite are best-effort readings of the handwriting.
